result.summary: Found 2 layout issues: the 'Tokumaru Ramen' title is clipped to 'Tokumaru Ramer' and the lower popular restaurant card is cut off by the bottom navigation.

issues.description: Restaurant name under 'Popular right now' is visually clipped and reads as 'Tokumaru Ramer' with the final 'n' cut off despite having full screen width available
issues.suggestion: Fix text container width, padding or overflow to prevent clipping and ensure the full name 'Tokumaru Ramen' displays, using ellipsis truncation only if needed

issues.description: Bottom pizza restaurant card (-20% badge) is cut off by the bottom tab bar with no name, delivery time or rating visible and no bottom scroll padding
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding / safe-area inset so cards scroll fully above the tab bar and their details are not obscured
